about: Poltergeist 2 ghost-machine layout, one entry per page (pages.common is on every page). Rects are [x, y, w, h] in the 1040 x 744 design canvas (the editor's W x H). Housings are painted into each page's background; moving parts and glows are sprites (assets/<page>/layers.json, assets/common/ui.json). "param" is the engine parameter (member of the Six Sines patch, as bound in p2-editor.cpp) or the MORPH parameter id; "pname" is its own display name; "action" is an editor function. "label" = the blank plate for the control's live name (and value, when the plate is two lines high). "sprite" / "sprite_lit" / "glow" / "flash" / "label_glow" = names in assets/common/ui.json (the moving part, its lit variant, its light, its spark, the light behind its label plate); chambers and other painted parts light through the sprites in assets/<page>/layers.json. "hit" (when present) = the pointer area where it is larger than the painted part in "rect". "face": the GHOSTS workbench shows one face at a time. "state": "roll" / "ledger" controls exist only while the brass roll / the preset ledger is down.

fx.about: SPECTRAL FX (SpectralFx in src/ghostblock/spectral/spectral-fx.h): four slots in series after the synth. The tall ghost carries the rack; the flying town is WarpCore (the parameters of the slot whose effect is WarpCore). "grp" = which craft a control rides on (ghost / town; none = the bridge rig): the two craft bob out of phase. The effect names, folders and the parameters of each effect are in "fx_effects" (from the upstream sources; the catalogue order of the engine is not final).

fx_effects.about: the slot effects. A slot runs in the order of its domain: Spectral + Partial (one shared STFT), then Time, then Warp (fixed by the engine: there is no order switch). The 8 wheels of the workbench are a slot's first 8 parameters (SpectralFx::pSlotParam, 0..1); "kind", range, unit and choices give the value text. Names and ranges are upstream's; the engine's catalogue ORDER is not final (provisional): refer to effects by "id".
